text: Online harassment: threatening messages, sharing images, blackmail. Take a screenshot → report to the platform → inform the wali al-amr (guardian) → 19099.

review_defects.why: The Arabic is indefinite 'ولي أمر' (a guardian), while the English uses the definite article 'the' and transliterates as 'wali al-amr', implying a specific guardian. The Arabic does not have the definite article.
